> 第3章 千金胆大（第1页）
“王爷，回王府吗？”侍卫兼车夫青锋看着暗下来的天色问。
今天闹这一出，要是把这姑娘带回王府过夜，那——
不过，马车里没传出那个少女声音了，她该不会被王爷直接掐死了吧？
青锋乱七八糟地想着，半晌，才听到自家王爷的声音。
过了一会，晋王的声音又响了起来。
丫鬟秋菊提着裙摆飞奔过来，人未至声先到。
陆昭云被吓了一跳，手里的针扎到了手指，一滴鲜红的血珠冒了出来。
“咋咋呼呼的做什么？谁不好了？”陆昭云气怒地瞪向窜进来的秋菊。
“大、大小姐回府了！”秋菊气喘吁吁，有些结巴。
“你喊谁大小姐？”陆昭云腾地站了起来，瞬间气炸。
秋菊被她这样狰狞的神情吓着了，赶紧改口，“奴婢说错了，是二小姐，二小姐回府了！”
“她怎么可能这时候回来？”陆昭云失声喊出来。
“真的！老爷夫人都在前厅迎着呢！”
“还要让我爹娘亲自去迎？她哪来这么大的脸！”陆昭云咬了咬下唇，“我去看看！”
“小姐等等，二小姐是被晋王送回来的啊！”秋菊赶紧追了上去。
陆明年约四十，长得年轻，外貌英俊，人模人样的。
陆夫人珠光宝气，衣裳艳丽，看着也不过三十出头。
“这位小哥，你说晋王把小女送回来了？就在门口？”
青锋面无表情，“是，陆昭菱陆小姐，是大人之女吧？”
陆明心头一跳，“确实是我那不成器的女儿，她人呢？”
“陆小姐身体不适，请大人找两个人出门扶她。”
陆夫人眼睛一瞪，不敢思议，“她自己到了家门口还不能进来，还得让人去扶？乡下养大的孩子怎么能娇气成这样子？太不像话了！”
青锋看了她一眼，只觉得陆昭菱长得和陆夫人一点都不像。
陆明低斥了她一句，“吵什么？没听到晋王送她回来的吗？”他赶紧叫了两个家丁过来，自己也理了理袍子，“去迎晋王。”
“陆大人准备让他们去扶陆小姐？”
两个男人去扶？陆大人是在开玩笑吗？
“对对对，我这一听到晋王回京了，激动得脑子不清楚，夫人还不赶紧叫两个丫鬟？”陆明反应过来。
“就她事多！依我看，她肯定是使着法子要让我们亲自去大门口迎她！”陆夫人小声哔哔，咬牙切齿的。
陆昭云赶了过来，立即跟上。她挽住了陆夫人的手臂，“娘，真的是晋王送二妹妹回来的？”
晋王，他们不熟啊。但陆昭云知道，沈相的千金可是从小就惦记着晋王的。
沈小姐京城贵女之首，被她惦记着的男人，肯定不一般！

The emperor’s uncle borrowed some merit, and the princess painted the talisman to impress An Qing’s heart. The latest chapter_Chapter 3 The Boldness of a Daughter of Gold Page 1_The emperor’s uncle borrowed some merit, and the princess drew the talisman to impress An Qing_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 3 The Boldness of Daughter of Gold (Page 1)
"Your Majesty, are you going back to the palace?" Qing Feng, the bodyguard and coachman, asked looking at the darkening sky.
After all the trouble today, if this girl is brought back to the palace to spend the night, then——
However, the girl's voice was no longer heard from the carriage. Could she have been strangled to death by the prince?
Qingfeng was thinking in confusion, and after a long while, he heard his prince's voice.
After a while, King Jin's voice rang again.
The maid Qiu Ju rushed over with her skirt in hand, arriving before anyone else arrived.
Lu Zhaoyun was startled. The needle in his hand pricked his finger, and a drop of bright red blood came out.
"What are you whirring about? Who's wrong?" Lu Zhaoyun glared angrily at Qiu Ju who ran in.
"The eldest, the eldest lady has returned home!" Qiu Ju panted and stuttered.
"Who are you calling Miss?" Lu Zhaoyun stood up and was instantly furious.
Qiu Ju was frightened by her ferocious expression and quickly changed her words, "I made a mistake. It's the second young lady. The second young lady has returned home!"
"How could she come back at this time?" Lu Zhaoyun shouted out loud.
"Really! The master and his wife are waiting in the front hall to welcome him!"
"You want my parents to come and greet her in person? How can she have such a big face!" Lu Zhaoyun bit his lower lip, "I'll go take a look!"
"Miss, wait a minute, the second young lady was sent back by King Jin!" Qiu Ju hurriedly chased after her.
Lu next year is about forty, young, handsome, and human-like.
Mrs. Lu is jeweled and dressed in gorgeous clothes. She looks like she is only in her early thirties.
"This little brother, you said that King Jin sent the little girl back? Right at the door?"
Qing Feng's face was expressionless, "Yes, Miss Lu Zhaoling, she is your Lord's daughter, right?"
Lu Ming's heart skipped a beat, "It is indeed my useless daughter. Where is she?"
"Miss Lu is feeling unwell. Please ask two people to go out and help her."
Mrs. Lu's eyes widened in disbelief, "She can't come in by herself when she reaches the door of her house, and she has to be helped by someone? How can a child raised in the countryside be so squeamish? How outrageous!"
Qing Feng glanced at her and felt that Lu Zhaoling looked nothing like Mrs. Lu.
Lu Ming scolded her, "What are you arguing about? Didn't you hear King Jin send her back?" He quickly called two servants over, and straightened his robe, "Go and greet King Jin."
"Master Lu, are you going to let them help Miss Lu?"
Two men to help? Master Lu, are you kidding me?
"Yes, yes, when I heard that King Jin had returned to the capital, I was so excited that my mind was unclear. Why don't you call the two maids quickly?" Lu Ming reacted.
"She's the only one with a lot of things! In my opinion, she must have tried some trick to get us to go to the gate to greet her in person!" Mrs. Lu whispered, gritting her teeth.
Lu Zhaoyun rushed over and followed immediately. She held Mrs. Lu's arm, "Mom, is it really King Jin who sent the second sister back?"
King Jin, they are not familiar with each other. But Lu Zhaoyun knew that Prime Minister Shen's daughter had been thinking about King Jin since she was a child.
Miss Shen is the most noble lady in the capital, and the man she is thinking about must be extraordinary!
